ownership.owns: The scikitplot multi-label dummy-encoding surface shipped as GetDummies and DummyCodeEncoder, including token expansion, category identity, unknown/infrequent/drop semantics, inverse transforms, sklearn estimator/output integration, feature naming, and focused regression tests.
ownership.does_not_own: Generic pandas.get_dummies behavior, sklearn OneHotEncoder/private utility internals, NumPy/SciPy sparse semantics, or the root scikitplot packaging/version infrastructure.

get_dummies.description: Pandas-backed selective multi-label expansion with passthrough columns in dense mode and dummy-only sparse mode.

dummy_code_encoder.description: Sklearn-style multi-label categorical encoder supporting dense/sparse output, manual categories, drop, unknown and infrequent-category policies, inverse transform, and set_output.

boundary_contract.feature_identity_rule: DummyCodeEncoder output identity is feature-local: equal category values in different input columns must occupy distinct output columns and remain inverse-transformable.
boundary_contract.infrequent_rule: When min_frequency/max_categories are enabled, transformed width/data, _n_features_outs, get_feature_names_out, drop behavior, and inverse_transform must describe the same grouped representation.
boundary_contract.parameter_rule: Documented enum-like GetDummies parameters must reject unsupported values rather than silently selecting a fallback behavior.
boundary_contract.sklearn_rule: Estimator clone/get_params/set_output/feature_names contracts remain coherent with returned dense/sparse matrices.
